Pilot 7/10/2024 5:58 PM Homie-Bot Hey there, welcome to Tagtreevivor! This is your confessional channel, where you'll be able to keep thoughts about the game, or anything else on your mind. Let's start with a few questions so the spectators can get to know you: Who are you? What's your story? What brought you to Tagtreevivor? What do you want to get out of this experience? The Depresso_Expresso 7/10/2024 7:26 PM Hello, I'm Depresso. I'm a student in Australia. I like acting and the arts and stuff like that. I was introduced to Tagtreevivor by a friend, they told me how this was an exciting event and I was hooked on by the idea, so...here I am! Ive never really done anything like this before, my days are using boring as hell. I guess what I want to get out of this is a chance to meet new people, maybe make friends and come out of my shell a little bit. kiara ig! 7/10/2024 10:25 PM (i am the friend) kiara ig! 7/12/2024 7:46 PM @snazztastic human beings Hihi it’s me Kiara! I hope y’all are having an amazing day, and also I’m here to ask you a few questions! 1. What’s your favourite animal and why? 2. What’s your favourite colour? (if you could give us a hex code as well that would be amazing!) 3. For each season, we’re going to be making a season playlist, with a song chosen from each of the castaways + production! Could you give us your song that you want on the playlist? (The only requirement is that it needs to be on Spotify, Ty!) 4. Throughout the season, we will come and ask you to rank your tribemates from top to bottom in terms of most to least trusted. There are no ties, and anything from a simple ranking from 1 to 5 or a full paragraph for each tribemate will suffice. Though we love to hear detailed thoughts from players. Your 1-5 ranking is due by 7 EST tomorrow in your confessional! Feel free to reply to this message with it once you do them The Depresso_Expresso 7/13/2024 1:47 AM Here are my answers: My favourite animal is frogs (although hamsters are also amazing) because they're little slimy bois who live out in the swamp, eating bugs and the colourful ones are poisonous. Favourite colour is . #256336 (dark green) The song I have chosen for the playlist is Mr Fox in the Fields by Alexandre Desplat. Just a chill song, nothing too crazy And finally...the rankings. 5- Edgy. Nothing against the guy, I just haven't talked to him at all compared to everyone else 4- KingofSpades. Again, nothing against him, just haven't talked with him as much as everyone else 3- DinoDan. 2- JimboTron. I have an alliance with him, so I trust him not to backstab me. 1- Treb. Really cool dude, probably have talked the most with him. Also, he's got a cute cat and pup (5 being lowest, 1 being highest) kiara ig! 7/13/2024 1:50 AM Yippie ty Pilot 7/13/2024 7:16 PM Homie-Bot BOT 7/14/2024 8:17 PM 1. How do you feel about your current position in the game? 2. Who do you trust the most and why? 3. How do you feel about your performance in the last challenge? 4. If you could have any superpower, what would it be? The Depresso_Expresso 7/14/2024 8:32 PM 1. I feel ok with my current position in the game and in the team. Am I 100% confident I wont be voted out? No. You can never be 100% in games like these. However, I have faith. 2. Honestly, the person I trust the most in this endeavour is probably Treb. We've talked to most and we get along well. I know I have an alliance with Jimbotron, but a great lady once said, words are cheap. But actions, they speak the truth. 3. Honestly, I believe our last challenge was not one any team would've been able to prepare properly for. Yes, we have to vote someone off, but is was going to happen at some point. Its a learning experience for the future. 4. If I had any superpower, Id want to have plant manipulation, like posion Ivy etc. I just like plants :) Pilot 7/15/2024 7:12 PM Homie-Bot BOT 7/16/2024 7:41 PM How are you feeling after the challenge? 2. If it were entirely up to you, who would you want to see voted out here? If your tribe is immune, what would you have done if you lost? 3. If you could have any animal, real or fictional, as a pet, what would it be? 4. We need Trust Rankings yet again by your voting deadline! This is bolded because it is important @snazztastic human beings The Depresso_Expresso 7/16/2024 7:51 PM 1. I'm feeling really great, honestly! I think we all did really well at we should all be proud of our accomplishment. 2. If it were entirely up to me, I don't know who I'd vote out. I don't know everyone in the other tribes, only having really talked to them during family feud. If we were not immune, however, I don't know who I'd vote off. It would be upsetting to see any of us go. 3. If I could have any animal, real or fictional, as a pet, I would have a german shepard. Its been my dream dog since I was a kid. Also, I think they would get along with my dog Narla. Trust as of now is the same (if I had to rank it (which I do)): 4- KingofSpades 3- DinoDan 2- Jimbotron 1- Treb Pilot 7/17/2024 8:12 PM kiara ig! 7/19/2024 2:45 AM Hi bestie how’s it going The Depresso_Expresso 7/19/2024 6:49 AM hello :) kiara ig! 7/19/2024 9:57 PM HELLO HAMPTERS! its me your favourite, kiara! And I'm back with a few questions! 1. Did you enjoy the challenge? 2. Do you think there will be more with the hamster cage or is it just a one time thing? 3. Do you like how the swap tribes ended up? Did it go good or bad for you? 4. Trust Rankings!! This is bolded cause we need them pls and thankyou @snazztastic human beings 9:59 PM id 9:59 PM did 9:59 PM you The Depresso_Expresso 7/19/2024 9:59 PM you saw nothing kiara ig! 7/19/2024 9:59 PM just copy and paste them and press send on accident The Depresso_Expresso you saw nothing kiara ig! 7/19/2024 9:59 PM we have the logs, [full name here] The Depresso_Expresso 7/19/2024 10:36 PM 1. Honestly, this challenge was very stressful and required alot of teamwork, which is hard for tribes that were only just formed 2. I think there is more to the hamster cage. Someone may have gotten whatever was there before I could, but that doesn't mean its empty. We just.....have to dig a little deeper. 3. Im a bit scared. Most of our team are people from Rov and I only have DinoDan from Sov, which places us in the minority. 4. I don't know if I can rank everyone equally, since Ive only just met these new people, but here's a rough ranking: 1 - DinoDan. We're the only ones from Sov on Golden and we've already planned to make sure we dont get voted off. 2 - Robert and Austin. They both talked on joining me and Dino, which means if they keep their word, they are great Allies. Also they both seem very well rounded as seen in the challenge 3- I haven't gotten to know everyone else alot as of now, but they seem cool. Whether I can trust them or not, howeve, is to be figured out kiara ig! 7/19/2024 11:02 PM Could you give us a ranking of each player for trust? The Depresso_Expresso 7/19/2024 11:03 PM I can try 1- DinoDan 2- Robert 3 - Austin 4 - Gavino 5 - Drock 6 - Ghoody Pilot 7/21/2024 1:00 PM Pilot 7/22/2024 8:07 PM Homie-Bot BOT 7/23/2024 9:23 PM 1. Trust rankings At a minimum, submit these before 7/24/2024 7:00 PM 5. What does your perfect day look like? The Depresso_Expresso 7/24/2024 6:19 AM 1. No, I dont feel safe at all. Rank is as follows: DinoDan Austin Drock Ghoody Gavino 5. It will be a matter of watching how it goes but I do think I trust them the most currently to not fuck me over yet. How do you feel about your performance in the last challenge? LIKE WHAT YOU DO WITH EVERYONE (edited) 1 10:31 PM GOSH KILL EM GIRL 10:31 PM IM SO PROUD OF HER RN 10:31 PM MARCILLE I HOPE YOU READ BACK YOURE AN ABSOLUTE QUEEN 10:32 PM I wanted to stand up for you so much more than I did I kept you safe for as long as I could without people pinning us as a women’s alliance. I was worried the whole time about burying your game I hope you make it to the end I really do! And I hope you can forgive me for not sticking up for you as much as I should’ve 1 10:38 PM GOD I ADORE HER 2 2 2 10:38 PM I can’t do stuff like that I don’t have the stomach for it 10:38 PM UGH SHES SO COOL 10:38 PM 10:42 PM I’m drinking in this moment 10:42 PM She’s been so polite and I’ve had to choke down sooooo many statements that dismissed her this season 10:43 PM It’s vindicating really and she did it all on her own- I got worried people would credit me for everything, but there’s so much she’s been doing and no one ever knew Shannon 8/10/2024 10:51 PM https://discord.com/channels/1213267992494739516/1266586056786968647/1272024245744042057 Austin you know I love you- but you gotta let this go 1 Shannon 8/10/2024 11:09 PM OOOOOOOOO NOW IM PISSED 1 11:09 PM OOOOHOOOHOHOHOHOOO 11:09 PM OOOOOOOOOOOO 11:10 PM I need to BITE something 11:10 PM 1 11:12 PM ID DO A VOICE MEMO BUT I CANT ANYMORE 11:12 PM LEMME JUST 11:12 PM OOOOOOOOO 11:12 PM Okok 11:12 PM I hate to do this- please know I don’t dislike either of these people AT ALL- but a comparison needs to be made 11:15 PM How come Drock can say virtually nothing to people all game, make very little effort of communication, and it’s “oooo underdog story” “oooo secret power player!” But Marcille does allegedly the same thing and it’s “she doesn’t play the game.” “she’s just a goat” and you CANT tell me I’m left out of it all cause at some point EVERYONE has confirmed with me that Drock didn’t communicate with them well either. WHY IS MARCILLE KICKED IN THE TEETH FOR IT 11:16 PM https://discord.com/channels/1213267992494739516/1266586056786968647/1272030370069741648 Austin boo-boo you aren’t even attempting to fit in my shoes Shannon 8/10/2024 11:27 PM My ears are ringinginginging 11:27 PM I’m not very good at like- 11:27 PM Puffing out my chest and whatnot 11:27 PM But dangit- this is ridiculous Shannon 8/10/2024 11:35 PM I hope I did a good job 1 1 11:35 PM I don’t really know 1 11:35 PM Thanks Robert 1 Shannon 8/10/2024 11:43 PM God why do I want to apologize 11:44 PM I spoke up- I dunno how people do this 11:46 PM I know some people do this and it’s a “girl boss moment” but stars anytime I do I just feel like a bitch I’m better when I’m happy- that’s who I am! I really hope people don’t take this one moment of mine and spin it into something it isn’t. I swear I normally have a far tighter grip on my emotions I think it’s just late 11:47 PM I’ll give my opinion and stand up for myself just fine, but the second someone pushes back on it I’m like “sorry you’re right my bad” I know I have a spine, but I think it’s just made of bones not grit 1 1 kiara ig! 8/10/2024 11:51 PM do you have an exoskeleton 11:52 PM sorry wrong time Shannon 8/10/2024 11:52 PM No it’s the perfect time 11:53 PM And no I do not 11:59 PM I kinda like having skin tho- I have favorite freckles and everything 12:03 AM Ok Marcille is starting to lose me a bit player is very different from person 12:03 AM Someone can have a “parasitic” or “villainous” game, but be an absolute peach of a person 12:04 AM Take Dicy for example they get villainous roles all the time in these orgs, but golly gee if they aren’t a gem of a friend 1 1 kiara ig! 8/11/2024 12:06 AM no dicy sucks >:( 12:06 AM @Dicy Shannon 8/11/2024 12:06 AM No Dicy slander in my confessionals!! This is a respect Dicy zone! Shannon 8/11/2024 10:05 AM Oh mah gah- my edited TRs aren’t goin throooouggh AAAA Shannon 8/11/2024 8:24 PM Treb knew my “you betcha” for the challenge he won 8:24 PM I’m so touched by that LOL Shannon 8/11/2024 8:34 PM D-Did Marcille actually just forget to submit a parchment for me? LOL I THOUGHT SHE WAS BLUFFING 1 8:35 PM I thought she SV’ed in the name of friendship girl what the weird PFFT Shannon 8/11/2024 9:03 PM I.. I sure do hope Drock knows he has to say more than “Hi” to me to get my vote 1 1 Shannon 8/11/2024 9:13 PM https://discord.com/channels/1213267992494739516/1272335688016068659/1272361556860211211 9:16 PM Perhaps he just.. doesn’t like writing stuff? 9:16 PM He always talked like he’s in such a rush- like he literally would rather be doing anything else 9:16 PM It’s cute that he applied with his Dad though how fun!! Shannon 8/12/2024 4:17 PM @Production when will my confessional get closed? 4:17 PM I wanna make sure I have time for final thoughts and whatnot Pilot 8/12/2024 4:18 PM we can leave it open as long as you'd like Shannon 8/12/2024 4:18 PM YIPPEEEE thank you! 4:19 PM People are being very flattering about my game LOL I didn’t realize everyone thought I was doing so well 1 Shannon 8/12/2024 6:32 PM MY GIFTS FOR PRODUCTION GOT CORRUPTED NOOOOOO 6:33 PM I’ll make new ones- I can’t believe it 6:35 PM I cannot edit my trust rankings, so I’m going to be replying to those I didn’t get to write notes for 6:35 PM Shannon I’ll make new ones- I can’t believe it kiara ig! 8/12/2024 6:39 PM how could you :( Shannon TRS: 1.) Treb 2.) Austin 3.) Gavino 4.) Marcille 5.) Dan 6.) Horse 7.) King 8.) Drock Shannon 8/12/2024 6:49 PM 1.) Treb OOOP- you shocked? Shouldn’t be- of coooourse he’s here! I’m honestly so lucky we solidified ourselves as a duo Even now in this cycle where we go back and forth about Horse’s fate I still can’t help but trust and love him It’s so refreshing to have his perspective around! It’s wonderful 2.) Austin AYYYOOOOOO!! Continuing to reach top charts absolute gem! He’s finally seeming to get his footing in the game which is just wonderful I still cannot believe this is his first discord org! He has so much potential here Kinda gotta keep an eye on that though- can’t have him getting toooooo good I’d be proud tho LOL 3.) Gavino GATOR BOOOOOOY!!! Honestly just a blast and a half to have around at this point Unlike Austin , Gavino hasn’t quite solidified his place in the game yet, but I don’t mind He seems to be having fun with it and is taking it easy which is good for him He is deserving of the good times 4.) Marcille Let it be known that I probably trust her more than literally anyone else not to vote me out or make a move against me PFFFT We just don’t talk game like the others, so it feels a tad strange to have her higher y’know? Not that I think it’s a bad thing! Quite frankly I wouldn’t have it any other way Being able to just have fun with someone else and trust them for it is such a lovely experience!! I can’t begin to overstate how glad I am to have made this connection with her LOL 5.) Dan DAN my MAN Honestly he hasn’t really given me much of a reason to distrust him LOL he’s been elated to join alliances, works with people well, and I know of his advantage He’s also seeming to get a better handle on the game after getting swap screwed, so I’m happy for him for that He’s a real peach! 6:49 PM 6.) Horse AAAA SORRY BESTIE This was a bit of an odd placement to figure out I do somewhat trust Horse not to plot against me, and I just adore having him around Buuuuut the paranoia is really getting to me I can’t have him planting seeds of doubt for my game and plans- especially to Treb Still adore the guy tho! Part of me kinda hopes he makes it 7.) ️ King ️ THE MAN THE MYTH THE LEGEND! I swear- the more I learn about this man the more baffled I become What a talent!! Even in the game his talents shine through- it ain’t fair The darling is only this low because I knoooow he’s got the game sense to be a real power player and I just can’t let that happen LOL I wouldn’t mind if he went far tho 7.) Drock Y’all I swear I have nothing against this man LOL We just don’t talk It sucks cause I know that he can- the VCs are very fun and he can be so lovely! I dunno why that doesn’t reflect in our 1 on 1s the man doesn’t even try and it makes me feel so strange- like I’m taking up space or something LOL I just wish he’d be more friendly I’m sure we’d have a great game together that way! kiara ig! how could you :( Shannon 8/12/2024 6:49 PM I spent like 20 minutes trying to salvage it but they’re so busted I promise imma get yall something! I’m so sad that they got ruined kiara ig! 8/12/2024 6:55 PM am i first on prod trust rankings Shannon TR: 1.) Treb 2.) Marcille 3.) Gavino 4.) Drock 5.) Austin 6.) Dan Shannon 8/12/2024 6:58 PM 1.) Treb Talk about TRUST! This man just blew the game wide open for me A whole secret alliance.. my name getting thrown out!?! Me leaving would be sooo beneficial for his game, so the fact that he wants me to stay is so touching Any doubts I had about him have just melted away- I trust him completely, my beautiful rat He’s just the best UGH! I gotta try the whole 2nd confessional strat more often this is wonderful!! 2.) Marcille I honestly feel a tad silly for not having you up here in the first place girlie game or not- you haven’t done a single thing to make me think you’re coming for me and my TRs should’ve reflected that Y’all she’s incredible- everyone else in this game is missing out LOL so glad we’re working even closer now This rules! 3.) Gavino Can’t believe they threw a gator to the sharks I’m sad to see him kinda getting pushed to the side in this game too! I do trust him even more now though- knowing he never had any intentions of getting rid of me at any point And NOW we get to make big kid moves together How thrilling!! 4.) Drock The fact that this man got roped into the whole mess is hilarious with me LOL say what you want about this man, but at least he’s honest I really hope he continues to want to keep me around, but I don’t blame him if this whole thing makes him kinda nervous. Though perhaps the nervousness may make him open up to me talk about silver linings!! 4.) Austin My bestie noooo Let it be known I don’t hate this man nor blame him for conspiring against me LOL this trust is fully from a game perspective- Austin darling I still think you’re a beyond stellar person and a fabulous friend It’s a smart move to go against me at this point anyway- don’t blame him for it a bit But I hope he can understand why I can’t trust him in the game right now- there’s just too many factors against him and stuff that’s against me! 6.) Dan AAAA YOU SNEAKY LITTLE MAN You almost got me!! I dunno why you told Marcille but thanks for that PFFFT! Honestly major props to him He was the only one to really go for it y’know? Of course I wasn’t gonna let it work out, but it’s commendable Much respect to you Dan you wild man 6:59 PM Ahhh all better 3 7:00 PM I’ll make final statements when it’s all truly final Thank you to everyone who has watched or supported me at one point or another! It means the moon and all the stars to me 2 Shannon 8/12/2024 8:18 PM Final Statement coming tomorrow! For now, I just wanna enjoy it all 2 Shannon 8/13/2024 7:55 PM 7:55 PM All done! Wow- what a wacky journey I enjoyed this far more than I could’ve ever expected really! I went into this with very low expectations- I only really wanted two things: Make it to jury and win an individual immunity and by golly I did ONE OF THEM Don’t feel too bad for me though- if you remember waaaaay back to the very first day, I had something I wanted to prove to myself You are good, even when not at your best I fell short of plenty of things this season! I bungled my confessional schedule, I got emotional, I don’t think I ever used that confessional VC of mine, I let files get corrupted, I didn’t win a single immunity for myself, I could barely be bothered with advantages, and I got voted out right around when I was wanting to stay for longer. And I loved every minute of it I recognized my shortcomings but I was fine nothing went bad, no one hated me, and most importantly- I didn’t beat myself up for it I just enjoyed myself and I feel better for it! I also did far more for myself as the game went on! Listening to a 200 episode podcast was not on my ORG bingo BUT DANGIT IM SO GLAD IT HAPPENED Have a second confessional through a little rat man who ended up taking the whole thing home?? MORE OF THAT PLEASE I made big moves, I made big alliances, and I made even bigger circles of friends Shoot what a blast and a half I couldn’t have predicted any of it LOL I’m honestly shocked my game got as much praise as it did- I’m very grateful for it though! I like to surround myself with exceptional people, and ORGs are no different I’m often so starstruck by the others around me, I forget that I’m kinda cool too this is just a very nice reminder of that I don’t really think I can compare this ORG to my other ones- each of my experiences and the people I play with have been so unique! But I will say this was the perfect cast and the perfect ORG for me to play rn I wouldn’t have changed a thing about it- I’ll be living and loving on so many of these experiences for as long as my memory allows It’s not what it used to be though, so please keep making memories with me- I’ve never been good with endings This just serves as my general thank you to everyone Whatever role you played in this, big or small, I am very grateful for it! Until next time Stay sweet! (edited) 6 6 6 5 Exported 1,032 message(s) Timezone: UTC-5

Alice in Bordeland on Netflix Pilot 7/29/2024 7:12 PM Kingofspades 7/29/2024 7:12 PM THIS IS NOT COOL 7:12 PM THIS IS NOT VERY COOL FOR KINGOFSPADES 7:12 PM WHY WAS I NOT INFORMED OF THIS Kingofspades 7/29/2024 9:30 PM Ok I no longer feel safe around Dan 9:30 PM I do however feel safe with Horse 9:31 PM I will not however trust Treb until Dan is gone Kingofspades 7/30/2024 3:50 PM Ok so the vote is jumping back and forth between Drock and Marcille atm 3:51 PM At least it is in the eyes of Horse, Treb and myself 3:51 PM If we take out Drock, it alienates Austin and Gavino which technically clears the path for an easy two more votes 3:51 PM but I dont like my odds when we get to f6 in that scenario 3:51 PM Whereas if we vote Marcille 3:52 PM We're making Austin and Drock happy by giving them a spot that isnt on the outs 3:52 PM And taking a vote out of Shannons corner 3:52 PM Setting us up to take out Shannon and then Dan Homie-Bot BOT 7/30/2024 9:24 PM 1. How are you feeling going into this vote? 2. Is there anyone you want to see go home? Any one you don't want to see go home? 3. What do you think is in the hamster cage? Have you thought about advantages in the game at all? 4. What's the worst movie you've ever seen? Homie-Bot BOT 7/30/2024 9:35 PM Secret additional question! trust rankings please! Kingofspades 7/30/2024 11:39 PM 1. I feel GREAT going into this vote. Not a care in the world. But fr I think voting Drock here is going to work out well for me 2. I want Dan gone. I want Horse gone. I want Shannon gone. I want Treb here. I want Austin here. Everyone else will get dealt with at some point 3. Hopefully it’s an immunity idol because I fucking want it. I know there are at least two extra votes but I know exactly where they are 11:39 PM 4. FucKING UNCUT GEMS WITH ADAM SANDLER 11:40 PM TRUST RANKINGS Kingofspades 7/31/2024 11:53 AM 1. Treb: My boy. My one and only. We’re going to the end as long as you don’t make any big impressive plays and continue to be my lil guy 2. Horse: I TRUST you. Doesn’t mean I want you here. You’ve had a helluva game brother but the roads gotta end for you soon 3. Austin: I think you’ve told me a couple lies but I believe, that you believe, that I’m your path to ftc 4. Shannon: My platonic queen id give you the world. And also give you my vote around f5ish 5. Marcille: I think as far as she knows we’re still in an alliance? Clearly closer with Shannon and some of the others but no animosity towards me. 6. DinoDan: I’ve had a feeling that he didn’t trust me for a little while now, but continuing a lie after he was already caught in it sealed the deal for me 7. Drock: poor guy knows he’s at the bottom and I’m sure he’d do anything for anybody to change that 11:54 AM 8. Gavino: something about him is just off. I think he sees me as a threat and a nonstarter for a late game ally Pilot 7/31/2024 8:32 PM Kingofspades 8/1/2024 1:56 AM So some of you may be wondering 1:57 AM “Kingofspades! You just led a vote to eliminate one of your closest allies in the game! Wtf!” 1:57 AM To which I would respond 1:57 AM “Don’t question my shit. I do what the fuck I want” 1:58 AM But in all seriousness, yeah horse was willing to take me and Treb to the end but at the rate things were going, horse was going to continue calling the shots the whole game and by the time FTC rolled around he would have stomped both of us 1:59 AM Making an aggressive move this early is gonna look good on my ftc resume. Unfortunately I may not get horses vote bc of it but I think Ghoody and Jimbo will respect it Homie-Bot BOT 8/2/2024 10:14 AM 1. How do you see yourself placing in this game? 2. How do you feel about your game this ORG versus in previous ORGs you've played? If this is your first, how do you feel you can improve if you play again? 3. What topic do you feel you could talk about for hours? 4. Switching things up! Rather than trust rankings, we're asking for power rankings, rank each of your tribe mates based on how likely you feel they are to win this game Kingofspades 8/2/2024 2:10 PM 1. I absolutely can smell first place. I just have to keep playing my game the way its been going so far. Systematically removing threats as they come up and be prepared to argue my ass off to the jury 2. My last ORG I placed 12th as the first person voted out during the merge. Ive already surpassed that and it looks like I'll make it even further than I am now 3. Music and Pokemon. I consider myself an expert in both 2:10 PM POWER RANKINGS Kingofspades 8/2/2024 2:18 PM 1. Treb: With the two of us working together and playing the field, I really do believe that we are going to be 2/3 of the FTC. I need to be careful though. If he makes another impressive play Im going to need to get rid of him. I cant have his resume ourtshining mine 2. Shannon: I am terrified of this woman. I have so much respect for her and I'd absolutely condider her a friend... and I think everyone else feels the same. if she makes FTC I think it'll be a landslide victory for her 3. Drock: Homeboy has the makings of a comeback story of the century. I can't allow him to make FTC either or he'll have such an impressive run dodging death repeatedly that hell even I'd vote for him 4. Austin: I think hes got some sneaky sly alliances throughout the playing field rn and Im worried hes gonna weasel his way farther than I'd like him to go. I'd also prefer he not make FTC 5. DinoDan: I think he started off really strong, but he's been gradually losing his closest allies and hasn't been at the forefront of many plays besides POTENTIALLY the Jimbo vote 6. Marcille: I feel like she hasn't shown herself as a challenge cevant or a social powerhouse, but I do worry that she cracked the cipher and solved the hamster cage 7. Gavino: I really know nothing about this guys game. His goals, his moves, his alliances, all of it is for the most part a mystery. But whatever those end up being... I dont think theyll be impressive 2 Exported 153 message(s) Timezone: UTC-5

I'm kinda stealing Austin's final words here but you are one of the nicest people I've met here on Discord. I apologize, I'll do a blue jay sin next time Kingofspades 7/20/2024 8:12 AM You’re all good 8:13 AM Man I really thought we were winning that challenge Eck 7/20/2024 8:14 AM We had some issues but we weren't that far behind. I feel bad I didn't help nearly as much and actually pulled people in the wrong direction Kingofspades 7/20/2024 8:18 AM I’m kinda concerned because I was working the whole time 8:18 AM I really hope my name isn’t being thrown out Eck 7/20/2024 8:19 AM Hmm that's troubling. Yeag i agree. Hey what Fantasy/D&D class do you like the most? This will impact our future. Kingofspades 7/20/2024 8:20 AM I am the all time dm, but in the very few times I’ve been a pc, I’ve enjoyed cleric and ranger the most Eck 7/20/2024 8:22 AM Very good choices fantastic. 8:25 AM You gotta tell me some of your DM stories and I'll say if I hear your name yes good deal Kingofspades 7/20/2024 8:43 AM My personal favorite was when one of my characters was inflicted with madness from a magical surge, but his character didn’t know about it. So instead of telling the player he was inflicted with madness I pulled him to the side and spun this elaborate story about how during the last dungeon crawl they were in he was blessed by the god of the desert. And how he now had the ability to summon an earth elemental by eating sand 8:43 AM When he tried it and it didn’t work I said “you must have did it wrong” 8:43 AM So he spent weeks trying different types of sand and different methods of eating it Eck 7/20/2024 8:49 AM That poor poor fool, his belly is full of sand elementals now Kingofspades 7/20/2024 9:09 AM That guy went down such a crazy corruption arc Eck 7/20/2024 9:21 AM We love a player who commits 9:22 AM I'm also forever DM Kingofspades 7/20/2024 9:30 AM Oh yeah? Well now I need one of your stories Eck 7/20/2024 9:32 AM Sure! Give me a minute 9:36 AM Ah uhm! A player character was looking for his wife Happy and kids after they were split apart in a terrible storm caused by a Geomancer Cult. It was a bit traumatic! Oh his journey the PC found one of his sons in the forest who revealed a Cult member killed the others who wanted to sacrifice him. Before the son could thank the cultist a ritual started and they both ran. Later on the player reached a Castle taken over by the Cultists. They were doomsday people constantly talking about how the end was coming through natural disaster, wanting to prepare themselves and others for the incoming horrors. Either way players infiltrated the castle by donning the unform, baggy blue robes and a white mask. They find a bunch of likable NPCs who are just a tad silly honestly or misguided and that's where the PC finds the cultist who saved his son. She had a gravely voice and introduced herself as Sorrow, saying it was best to recruit the boy then sacrifice him. Ricky didn't agree with that but thanked her anyway. Sorrow was going to be honored by the head cultist, but her treachery was found out. She was going to be electro-executed before the PC yelled to the party it was a trap noticing the gifted weapon was super charged. Sorrow and the Party fought together and won! Afterwards Sorrow and the PC talked to one another for a bit, she just wanted to make sure the boy was safe from all this, and thanked Rocky for being a good dad. They exchanged crystal numbers and went their seperate ways. Then Sorrow called Rocky once she was about to get out of range. She promises to grow stronger to protect her kids, and knew if she revealed herself in his presence she wouldn't be able to continue her journey of self improvement and discovery. Both the PC and Player had a movie like flashback. He recounted all the clues out loud, saving his son, gravely voice, knowing his name was Rocky, betraying the cult, giving him his favourite food. She was Happy. Rocky was befuddled, another player was embarrassed they were beefing so heavily with his wife. She promises to help find more of their children and to be strong enough to protect them from disasters and cultists herself. The call ended. Kingofspades 7/20/2024 11:31 AM That’s a pretty cool plot!! Eck 7/20/2024 11:33 AM Yeyeye! I heard 2 other names Kingofspades 7/20/2024 6:49 PM Oh that’s definitely worrying to hear Eck 7/20/2024 6:49 PM Yeah me and Jimbo Kingofspades 7/20/2024 6:50 PM I can switch my vote to Jimbo if you think that’ll help things. We’ve still got 10 minutes to figure this out Eck 7/20/2024 6:50 PM If you don't mind Kingofspades 7/20/2024 6:50 PM Yeah no problem Eck 7/20/2024 6:51 PM I don't want to force you or anything Kingofspades 7/20/2024 6:52 PM Jimbo and I never really talked on Sokolov so I don’t mind voting him Eck 7/20/2024 6:53 PM Understood 6:54 PM Also aside Baheeyem deserves a signature ability Kingofspades 7/20/2024 6:55 PM Beheeyem deserves the world❤️ Eck 7/20/2024 6:56 PM Like what about Pixelate but for Psychic, maybe special moves instead of normal 6:56 PM Or just like 'Beam/Ray' attacks get boosted 1 6:57 PM Mega Launcher Kingofspades 7/20/2024 6:58 PM Laser Cannon Eck 7/20/2024 7:00 PM Hyper Beam, Ice Beam, Solar Beam, Psy Beam, Bubble Beam. Each of you must submit a vote to eliminate one of your fellow tribemates in your submissions channel by the deadline tomorrow. You may change your vote as many times you would like up until the deadline, but once the deadline passes your vote is locked, and can no longer be changed. The deadline to submit your vote is 7/17/2024 7:15 PM 20 minutes before the deadline, we will begin live Tribal Council, where a member of Production will ask you questions about the game and your experience thus far. When the deadline hits, the live advantage period will begin. You will have 5 minutes to play any advantages you may have found. If you wish to play an advantage but will not be online at this time, you may pre-play it in your submissions channel and we will play it for you. To submit your vote, use any image-editing software to write or type the player's name on our parchment, then send it in your submissions channel. You may decorate your parchment, but make sure it is clear who you are voting for. Wow; what a season it was for all of us huh? Obviously my first season has come to an end but I'm damn proud of my game. I hope you guys are; well you guys all told me you were and all voted me because of it but yeah. Gavino getting to know you on day 1 and not just the little stuff but the deeper stuff too and building that true connection with you was very special and something that can't be replicated. Shannon you're one the kindest souls on the planet. You know how to always make a laugh. We built a strong and true friendship. Learning about you and talking to you for 27 days,(except when we were separated), was very special and I'm glad to share a wavelength with you any time. Drock... You're one of the coolest and genuine guys I have met. I'm so glad you stayed over Sunder because you were the most enjoyable player to play this game with. I love how you always keep your head high even with the amount of votes you receive. Your work effort is also so respectable and keep up the great work at your job. Godspeed my friend. Marcille; I wish we talked more. I really do. When having a conversation with you it was always sweet and wholehearted. I wish we talked more game than the last 30 minutes we did of my game. I don't know much about you but from what I did know; you're a kind, genuine and smart person. Treb. You're a great guy and an even better photographer. You're also one of the most smart and strategic guys I know. Your best quality is how level-headed you are. Your ability to use your common sense and always stay calm; I admire that greatly. Now for the game part there are some people who I feel won't be getting my vote but I still will have an open mind for FTC. Shannon and Treb; you both lost your shield. Now one of you are next. I fear it is you Shannon if you don't win immunity so best of luck girl. This game has been a lovely time and TTY at FTC Exported 158 message(s) Timezone: UTC-5

Pilot 10/23/2024 4:01 PM Hello! 4:01 PM Welcome to 4:01 PM # F11 - AMONG US CHALLENGE 4:01 PM 4:02 PM Here's how it works! We're going to simulate 5 separate games of among us at once . And each game will have 2 impostors, randomly chosen, with identities only known to each other. Meaning that all of you (with one exception) will be the impostor in exactly 1 game, and crewmate in the other 4. (1 person will be a crewmate in all 5 games) This challenge will take place over 2 phases, each 12 hours long. (edited) 4:03 PM Each phase you will perform an action in each of the 5 games, depending on whether you are a crewmate or an impostor in that game! 4:04 PM PHASE 1 Crewmate Submit a vote for someone who they believe is the impostor. Choose a location to guard: The options include: Electrical, Reactor, Communications, Med-Bay, and Navigation. Impostor Select a player you would like to kill! They will not be able to participate in phase 2 Submit a vote for someone to be eliminated 4:05 PM Only vote counts, and who is killed will be revealed publicly for each game. The players who are killed along with the player who receive the most votes will not be allowed to participate in phase two for those games. (edited) 4:06 PM PHASE 2 Crewmate Submit a vote for someone who they believe is the impostor. Impostor Choose one location to sabotage! (same options as crewmate to guard) Select a player you would like to kill! Submit a vote for someone who you would like to see eliminated. (edited) 4:08 PM And the end of phase 2: 1. The votes will be revealed, and the person voted out is eliminated from the game 2. If the impostor has not been voted out, they will try to sabotage on of the locations. archive / f13-immunity-challenge Dicy 10/18/2024 6:45 PM Final 13 Challenge: Pictionary Framework Today you will be partnering up with-in your tribes to complete a Framework Puzzle, But there's a twist! That twist being you will not have any scrambled words to guide you! Instead of the standard scrambled up words you will be using drawings and a letter bank to solve the words used for the puzzle! In your pair, you need to assign two roles: a "Drawer" and a "Solver" . The goal is to solve a Framework-like puzzle! Here’s how it works: Role Assignment: Once you partnered up and have your roles assigned, please ping us in your tribe chat with the list of pairs and roles! Drawer Responsibilities: The Drawer will run the command ?13-Pictionary-Framework , which will give them ten survivor based words they must illustrate (on their own, no tracing or anything similar) without using any numbers, letters, or words. They will have 15 minutes to complete their drawings. If they take longer than this time limit, their team will be disqualified. (DQ penalty explained in scoring) Solver Responsibilities: Once the Drawer submits all ten drawings, Production will notify the solver. Once the solver is ready, the drawings will be handed over to the Solver. The Solver must then deduce the ten words from the drawings and integrate them into a Framework puzzle. Scoring: The scoring for this challenge will be based on the number of correct answers in the puzzle. In case of a tie, the time taken from when the Solver requests the drawings to the moment the completed puzzle is submitted will serve as the tiebreaker. DQ's For going over the drawing time or A none drawer entering the command will be 1.5x the overall worst time. 6:45 PM 6:45 PM For anyone who is not familiar with a Framework puzzle in general here is an example of a standard Framework puzzle (however you will not get the scrambled words section) 6:45 PM 6:46 PM If you have any questions please ping me! Pilot 10/18/2024 7:27 PM Jax you're sitting someone out btw! Dicy 10/18/2024 8:09 PM Small little note: as a drawer if you are coming up on the 15 time limit you can choose to submit the drawings you have and not give your solver all ten to avoid a DQ. However the solver will only get those done to solve the framework Dicy 10/19/2024 7:01 PM @All Updates @snazztastic human beings I HAVE SOME RESULTS 7:01 PM to start with good news, it didn't end up going to tie breaker! 7:02 PM let us kick things off with what the ten words were to start with 7:02 PM the list of words used for this challenge are: 1.) Fire Making 2.) Final Three 3.) Under the Radar 4.) Buff 5.) Jeff Probst 6.) Rocks 7.) Water Well 8.) Tribal Council 9.) Survivor Auction 10.) archive / f5-immunity-challenge Dicy 11/2/2024 2:49 PM Dicy Challenge part 2, Welcome to your Final 5 Immunity challenge. # F5: Empty Space (edited) Dicy 11/5/2024 4:09 PM For todays Challenge I have created a bit of a puzzle chain for you to solve! There will be three different puzzle types that you will be solving, all that involve filling in the empty space. Once the puzzle is completed you will then use your completed to puzzle to find a hidden code within the puzzle, you will enter those hidden codes into their marked locations on the cover page to reveal the season logo. How you find these "hidden codes" will be clearly marked on each of the puzzles respect google sheet tab. you will know you have the Hidden code correct as a cell will change to a piece of the season logo, if it doesn't you are wrong. I will go ahead and tell you the three puzzle types that will be included in this challenge to allow for practice on your own before running the challenge. The three puzzles are: Framework Puzzle : a grid resembling a crossword, but instead of clues, you're provided with a list of scrambled words. Your goal is to fit these words into the grid, unscrambling them as you go. Numbrix Puzzle : consists of a grid of numbers. The goal is to fill in the grid with numbers in sequential order, starting from 1 and ending at the highest number given. Each number must be adjacent to the previous or next number in sequence, either horizontally or vertically. Some Numbers will be given to start the puzzle to guide your solve. Drop Quote Puzzle : a grid of squares and a set of given letters which “drop” into the grid. When the puzzle is solved, You will have a phrase of some kind. Within the grid, black boxes represent the spaces between words. some words may be broken between lines, starting at the end of one line and continuing to the beginning of the next line — words only end at black boxes or the end of the puzzle. The given letters at the bottom of a drop quote puzzle are organized by the column they “drop” into, and are given in alphabetical order. (edited) 4:13 PM The rules for the challenge are very straight forward: Enter the command !F5-Empty-Space (This will give you the google sheets page, MAKE A COPY) Solve each tabs Puzzle and send a screenshot for proof Solve the three Hidden Codes and enter them on the cover page to reveal the logo then send a screenshot of the completed cover page! Challenge will be due at Wednesday, November 6, 2024 8:00 PM if you have any questions please ping me in your submissions. archive / f6-immunity-challenge Cwiski 10/11/2024 7:22 AM F6: Rankings and Queens Hey y’all! Who’s ready for their second Cwis challenge of the season? So for this challenge, I drew inspiration from a jackbox game that some of y’all might be familiar with, it’s called Quixort . Here’s how todays challenge will work: Upon entering the command, you will be given 3 questions/prompts about the season, as well as their answers. Your goal for each prompt is to rank the answers in the correct order. An example prompt would look like this: Order the planets in our solar system from closest to furthest from the sun: Earth, Jupiter, Mars, Mercury, Neptune, Saturn, Uranus, Venus For simplicity sake and using the example above, I ask that you input your answers as such: Prompt 1: 1. Mercury 2. Venus 3. Earth 4. Mars 5. Jupiter 6. Saturn 7. Uranus 8. Neptune With a potential total of 30 points, you will earn one point per correct placement, and the castaway with the most prompts correctly placed will win individual immunity (with tiebreaker coming down to who took less time to submit from entering the command) Should there be any ties while ranking, the placement of the items within the tie do not matter. Hope that’s simple enough! Keep in mind that when you enter the command you will be given all 3 prompts at once, so plan your time accordingly. The command is "?f6-rank" Good luck and have fun (edited) Cwiski 11/3/2024 7:43 PM @Kireina Another Cwis Challenge! Go nuts and ping if you have any questions Cwiski 11/3/2024 8:01 PM Also no discussion of the challenge please and thank you! Cwiski 11/4/2024 6:27 PM @Kireina @All Updates who wants some early results?? 6:27 PM I do because I’m at the gym! 6:28 PM A small note: I made an Oopsie and didn’t establish that only the losing tribe attended f12 tribal, so there are different answers allowed for prompt 1, but it didn’t affect the overall outcome 6:28 PM ANYWAYS LETS DO IT 6:28 PM in 6th place is @3rd-Willow with 10/30 6:29 PM In 5th is @5th-Cinnamon with 22/30 6:29 PM In 4th is @2nd-Pigeon with 25/30 6:29 PM In 3rd is @1st-LN with 29/30 6:30 PM Meaning our two remaining players, @6th-IzzyB and @4th-Tyler both scored a 30/30! So it comes down to time 6:30 PM Izzy got a time of 23:48 6:30 PM Was Tyler able to beat that? 6:30 PM They… 6:30 PM . 6:30 PM . 6:30 PM . 6:31 PM Did! With a time of 19:26, @4th-Tyler wins immunity! 6:31 PM Congrats Tyler, if anyone has questions about your scores feel free to ask and I will get back to you after the gym Exported 20 message(s) Timezone: UTC-5

Guys I'm going to keep this short, sweet, and to the point: I love to game! Whether it be singleplayer or with friends, I am a gamer at heart! With this, I figured I would share my love of gaming with all of you, and have you compete in a gaming challenge! Isn't that so fun??? Last season I ran a speedrunning challenge, and this season I thought I’d do the opposite. Let’s take our time here, shall we? The challenge is simple: when you're ready you will enter the command "?f8-gamer" into your submissions channel. Upon entering the command, you will receive the link to the game you will be playing. The moment the command is entered, you will have 1 hour to achieve the highest score possbile you can in said game. The player who records the highest score will be the winner of individual immunity, with tiebreakers coming down to who submitted their score fastest within that hour timeframe. You may submit as many scores as you'd like within the hour, and we will be taking the highest score you submit! It's as simple as that! archive / f9-immunity-challenge Armuski 10/27/2024 6:34 PM F9: Beyond the stars! For this challenge, you'll be doing a few mini challenges! You can pick as many as you want, ranging in difficulty from 1-12. For every challenge you do, you get an amount of points, that being the amount that was stated on the difficulty. So if you were to do challenge nine, you would get nine points by completing it! If you were to FAIL a challenge however, you lose half of the points of that challenge AND any challenges you do afterwards will not count for your total. Let's say Aunder is doing their thing. They complete challenge one, three, and five. They sit at a pretty nine points. They feel cocky and go for challenge 12, but lose. That means they lose six points, and their challenge ends with him getting 3 points total. You can do them in any order you'd like, so feel free to start wherever you'd like! I heavily encourage having some sort of editing software on hand. The command for the challenges are "?planet-x" where x is the difficulty. But I’m for sure not going down without a fight 8:10 PM First bad impression on my list: WILLOW 8:10 PM for stupid reason 8:11 PM She doesn’t like Taylor 8:11 PM blacklisted! 8:11 PM I’m kidding 8:11 PM I’ll give her a chace. But she’s only 16. I usually don’t do well will people way younger than me 8:12 PM I just think they tend to overplay and be too overly social. Which makes them a threat 8:13 PM I’m that kinda player that if I see you’re a threat and it benefits me for 1-2 rounds, I’ll keep you. But if you’re a threat I realise EARLY in the game, I’m not afraid to take a shot 8:13 PM People LOVES keeping threat 8:13 PM and they always end up winning which is ridiculous 8:13 PM But oh wells, enough yapping for now! I’ll hit yall with trust rankings later on! 13th-Dar 10/5/2024 11:52 PM I’m having a slow ass start to the game and I didn’t expect this to be happening. Literally was in pain and had no other choice but to focus on my leg. I know I will be an easy target if we go to tribal but my goal now is to contribute to some points. 11:58 PM All I can do right now is, be present and not be completely gone. 11:58 PM Once I find my footing (no pun intended) after this challenge, I am confident I can ride it out far. 13th-Dar 10/6/2024 12:08 AM I like Kiera 12:08 AM we have the same music taste! 12:09 AM Threw in “Alliance? ” to her 12:09 AM sounds like it can happen! 12:09 AM Pichu and I connected a bit because of timezones 12:10 AM So I can see him being a pottential ally for me as well 13th-Dar 10/6/2024 11:25 AM Did some of the challenges, definitely felt so much better! 11:25 AM People have now “seen” me as an active player to say the least LOL 11:25 AM So hopefully they’ll value me and see me worth keeping if we happen to lose! 11:26 AM 3 people that I like so far are, Kiera, Pigeon and Pichu. 11:26 AM I can foresee all 3 of them being threats down the line…because they seem very very social. 11:26 AM So having them close to me is great 11:27 AM But…Im never afraid to get rid of them 11:27 AM I can play slighly dirty pre-merge lol, they aint a juror and they aint have a say ‍♂️ 11:27 AM So if I have to, I will Homie-Bot BOT 10/6/2024 7:12 PM Hi! Congratulations on completing your first challenge, please answer these questions to help us and the spectators get to know you better: What is your favorite color? If you could have any animal, real or fictional, as a pet, what would it be? How do you feel about your tribe? Please rank your tribe mates from 1-9, with 1 being the person you trust most, and 9 being the person you trust least, this MUST be done before 10/7/2024 7:00 PM Homie-Bot BOT 10/6/2024 7:21 PM @Cwuice : have you listened to the talk tuah podcast 13th-Dar 10/6/2024 8:29 PM YAYYYYYYY we won! 8:29 PM THANK YOU HOMIE 8:30 PM That means I won’t be the first boot oh my god! Keeping my NOT FIRST BOOT streak alive since 2022! 8:31 PM Well since you asked, my favourite colour is Olive Green and Purple! I know both are different spectrums but I just think both colours are nice and purple is very very pretty! 8:32 PM Hmmmmm I already have cats, but if I could…I would want a panda! 8:32 PM They’re so cute and clumsy, just like me lol 8:32 PM Just realised I just called myself cute 8:33 PM Lmao its okay, self love! 8:33 PM Now onto the game stuff! 8:34 PM I really think my tribe is strong as a whole, not really any inactive players. Well I haven’t heard much from Brad. But aside from that, Everyone seemed to be in it to win it! 8:34 PM So far the morale of the tribe is high and I am lowkey glad to be placed in a tribe with gamers 8:34 PM I do however worry about my placements in the tribe 8:36 PM But it’s too early to speak on this because we have not really tested any sort of trust between one another 8:36 PM I do have have people that I feel good about 8:36 PM My trust rankings will show it! 8:37 PM Trust Rankings 1. Pigeon 2. Alba 3. Kiera 4. Pichu 5. Cinnamon 6. Willow 7. Night 8. LN 9. Brad 8:41 PM I feel good about Pigeon and how i think they might include me in votes. In order to find my footing in this game, I need to be included. So i think Pigeon is someone that can get me included 8:41 PM So my work is to just build that relationship with Pigeon 8:42 PM In fact, Alba is someone who I think may not seem very active in this game 8:42 PM but 8:42 PM I feel good bout her 8:42 PM Just good vibes Homie-Bot BOT 10/6/2024 9:05 PM @KawaiiPrinski : who's a guest you'd wanna see on the talk tuah podcast Pilot 10/7/2024 7:11 PM 13th-Dar 10/7/2024 8:10 PM OKAY TIME TO UPDATE SOME CONFESSIONALS 8:11 PM Well yall this episode is going to be spicy! 8:11 PM 2 tribals, both tribes going oof 8:11 PM It’s important that I win this immunity and secure my safety 8:12 PM It’s still a bit of a slow start, I don’t know where everyone’s head is at 8:12 PM I know people will be sucking up to people like Pichu, Willow, Kiera, Pigeon and Cinnamon (edited) 8:12 PM That’s what my gut is telling me 8:13 PM Walking into this episode, I have to make sure I secure some sort of alliances with people 8:13 PM My target will be Brad since he is not talking to me but is still talking here and there in the tribe chat 8:13 PM That’s a red flag in my opinion 8:14 PM So Brad is going to be someone I’m throwing out if someone asks me how I feel 8:14 PM Brandy (20th) Brad (19th) (edited) 8:14 PM Seems fitting 13th-Dar 10/8/2024 9:57 AM JUST DID THE CHALLENGE! 9:57 AM Is it crazy to say that i might wanna search the word search for idols 9:57 AM 13th-Dar 10/8/2024 10:14 AM this works right? 13th-Dar 10/8/2024 10:39 AM GAME TALK Okay I’ve chatted with Cinnamon & Alba earlier, they both seemed to like me and would work with me. Both of them gave me a common name that they felt good with and that was Kiera. Whilst I like Kiera as well, this just shows that Kiera is well rounded and well liked. Which makes her a threat. Getting threats out are very tempting but this early in the game will be stupid. Soooo keeping Kiera and agreeing that she’s awesome can hopefully place me at a better position in this tribe. 10:41 AM Pichu is someone who I am interested in working with but his texts gave me 0 flavours. Could he just be a gamebot and not so much of a strategist? Possibly. THE BRIGHT SIDE IS…he mentioned that he spoke the least to Brad and thinks that Brad might be the vote. GREAT NEWS TO ME! 10:43 AM Willow…if I’m getting my reads right, I think Willow is also very sociable but at the same time a conversation killer! It was clear to me that people thought I didnt give a great performance in the first challenge based on Brandy voting me and saying so, and there were some people I didnt even get to talk about the vote the first tribal which is pretty bad. I always like to include everyone on the vote because if some dickhead voted before talking to me about it I like cant trust them. This tribal being automatic kinda sucked for me because I wanted to show a better effort in the second challenge and maybe avoid a tribal before the easy votes started to run out. I do love double tribals though because they speed up the game and allow you to the dynamics of both tribes if one wins every challenge. In the start of tribal, Brett was the first person I talked strategy with. He usually is because Ive talked to him the most and am most comfortable with him. I am though definitely aware of his threat level and how dangerous he is socially and likely strategically. If the opportunity comes to take him out I would take it before it becomes too late. However, that was unlikely to happen quick, which is exactly why its a good idea to remain his ally for a little while. Brett told me that Theo had supposedly thrown out Etay's name. I was revealed by this idea because I hadnt talked much to Etay, and it would be someone that wasnt me. So I then talked to Theo. Theo told me that he had no idea who to vote. This was an immediate red flag to me and got me extremely paranoid. So I came up with a plan to tell Theo that someone had told me that Theo had been spreading my name, and I wouldnt tell Theo who said this until either he admitted it or I was safe after tribal. This plan was a pretty last resort risky type plan, but I really felt like I had nothing else to do. Theo quickly replied to me asking who said it, and he mentioned both that he was thinking Etay for the vote, and that he thought I had actually put in a good performance in the first challenge. While Theo was telling me this, Brett messaged me saying "lets try not to have too much drama this tribal". Soooo I may have overreacted a littttle bit. I believed that Theo actually did want Etay out, but he was just being cautious in telling me about it at first. But... Brett clearly had heard from Theo what I was telling him. This let me believe that Theo and Brett were extremely close. It made sense to me because Theo seemed to have low standards for people he trusted, especially people who talk a lot, and Brett was the most active member on the tribe. Despite the mistake in having too much paranoia, I was still able to manage to flip this into a good move. I told Theo that I believed him now and that the person who told me this I thought was actually just trying to cause chaos. Without me having to propose it myself, Theo proposed that I tell him who said all of this after tribal if it were a simple unanimous Etay vote. So the next day, I talked to everyone and they all agreed that it should be a simple Etay unanimous vote, and that it was being spread around by the whole tribe. Etay had talked to me and told me that he simply wanted Theo out. 5:24 PM The only person to talk to was Brett. I knew I had to come up with something to tell him because I suspected that Theo had told him all I had told Theo. I would try to make the story like up perfectly with what I told to Theo. Brett told me that Etay had also told him Theo's name, and that Etay had heard Theo was spreading his name. So, I made up the lie that Etay had told me Theo told him that Theo wanted me out. This would create a scapegoat for this lie I made up to get information from Theo, and I would tell it to Brett first so he would think he has my trust. Me and Brett both agreed it could be a simple Etay vote. After this, I talked to Theo and told him that it was actually Etay who was just trying to cause chaos to save himself. Etay was voted out unanimously 8-1. I think that arguably Cinnamon, Alba, and you had a much better social game than me. It seems fairly apparent that you all are much more liked than I am (though I would argue maybe that that's a product of you being on the jury and having failed to vote out the people you tried to. People who are voted out don't often have people end up bitter at them). I will gladly give credit to Brett's strategic planning as well, it was fantastic and a major reason for why he was targeted so early in the merge (and ultimately met his demise at F7). I also would like to give props to Nate. He expertly navigated his pre-merge tribes and given how many tribals he was a part of it is a testament to his strategic planning that he made it to merge at all. However, I do not think anyone had a better combination of social / strategic planning than I did. Maybe I wasn't clear enough about the alliance opportunities that I had in the game, but I was offered or had implied final tribal deals with seven people in this game at one point or another (Brett, Tyler, Willow, Pigeon, Cinnamon, Alba, and Night). And I would be willing to bet that I was at or near the top of the trust rankings for each of those individuals (as well as Pichu) at one point or another in the game. That just simply does not happen if I have terrible social gameplay. As far as who I think deserves to be at the Final 3? I think that the only other person who deserves to be here besides the three that are actually here is Tyler. He was meant always meant to fill that 3rd slot and I wish I had had the opportunity to compete against both him and Willow in this final tribal. 9:48 PM @6th-IzzyB i'm not sure if you're here but i'll give you a few minutes if you need further clarification / have additional questions before moving on 6th-IzzyB who do you feel are your supporters in the jury? How do you think this vote is going to split? 6th-IzzyB 11/10/2024 9:54 PM @1st-LN 1st-LN 11/10/2024 9:54 PM Oh, I'm sorry, I completely missed that question 9:55 PM let me take care of that before moving on to @7th-Brett (sorry Brett) 9:59 PM I would like to hope that I could win the support of everyone on the jury. However I'd like to think my biggest supporters would be Brett, Pichu and possibly Alba (I hope she respects that I made what I believed to be a necessary game move and isn't too upset). I think as far as the split? I have no clue how it'll ultimately end up shaking out. I think both Willow and I have a very compelling case for victory. With pigeon having maybe less so (just because he had to be saved so many times during the game). (edited) Exported 15 message(s) Timezone: UTC-5

I feel decently confident in the info I gathered during that first part, and while I didn’t know if I could fully believe the duo allegations slung against you and dreya, I could sure as hell use them to my advantage. Now if you had stayed, I think my work around depends on context, if it’s something like an idol out with all hell, yeah I might scramble a bit both to you and others, but I was really well insulated for that vote I feel. If it was a general blindside, I’d like to think I would’ve known of it and played accordingly, or simply just play from the bottom (edited) 11th-Nate @2nd-Pigeon @1st-LN @3rd-Willow First of all I want to say if y'all don't think my opinion or my vote is here valid cause I was only here for a day or two I apologize. (Likely Dreya or Izzy) 2nd-Pigeon 11/10/2024 7:18 PM first off your vote is still valid anyways to answering the questions 1. the f11 round was going to be me trying to guarantee i had people around me that would keep me safe, find out wtf happened and how alba and pichu were still alive and try eliminate people I had fewer connections with hopefully, I was probably going to try and target you dreya or izzy 2. yes most likely, i feel like a vote out on you dreya or izzy was most likely going to happen anyways but it could have just as easily been on me 3. probably f10-8 might change order and stuff of what and i still have the f9 scare round for me, im not good at predicting how the past would have changed if something changed, never been somethign ive been good at. but i do think there was a possibility you staying would have caused my f9 death to occur 1st-LN 11/10/2024 11:28 PM hey @11th-Nate 11:28 PM sorry to leave you to last 11th-Nate @2nd-Pigeon @1st-LN @3rd-Willow First of all I want to say if y'all don't think my opinion or my vote is here valid cause I was only here for a day or two I apologize. How would you have worked around it if I had stayed, and someone else had left? (Likely Dreya or Izzy) 1st-LN 11/10/2024 11:38 PM Ultimately F11 was a combination of trying to figure out exactly what happened on the Lilly tribe as well as making sure that we didn't waste the first merge boot on necessarily an "easy" vote. I talked to both Alba, Pichu and yourself about what happened, and your story was different than theirs (and they gave the same story to Brett and Tyler and again, yours and Dreya's story was different from both one another's as well as Alba and Pichu's). From that, it felt fairly obvious that you were lying to me in order to lessen your threat level. That and both Pichu and Alba said you were a hard duo with Dreya. Because of that, I felt fairly resolved in that you needed to be voted out. My personal goal was to see you voted out and I absolutely believe that that would have happened if you'd actually made it to tribal. I spoke with Alba and Cinnamon and both agreed you were a major threat that needed to be taken out. My alliance with Brett/Me/Tyler was less in agreement with one another at first, with Brett wanting to take out Pichu, but after some pretty extensive conversation with him (and an agreement to let him target Pichu the following round), we finally came to an agreement that you would be voted. I am absolutely certain that if we had made it to tribal, you would have been voted out by a vote of 9-2 or 8-3 (depending on how Izzy ultimately voted). If you had stayed and someone else had left (due to an idol or some other advantage), I do believe you would have probably filled the boot slot of Dreya instead and been taken out at F9. In fact I feel pretty certain of that, because unlike Dreya, you would not have had the benefit of the all girls alliance potentially trying to keep you in the game. However, I want to reiterate, it was your strategic prowess on Lilly and Ilana that made it impossible to let you stay in the game, so it may have even been necessary to take you out at F10 instead of Pichu. 11th-Nate 11/10/2024 11:40 PM Alright, good answers from all of you. the expansive universe of Yu-Gi-Oh!, a trading card game (TCG) that has captivated millions since its inception in 1999, few cards are as iconic or as influential as "Pot of Greed." This card, renowned for its simplicity and power, has played a pivotal role in shaping the game's competitive landscape. This essay delves into the intricacies of Pot of Greed, exploring its mechanics, historical significance, impact on gameplay, and its status within the game's evolving ruleset. By examining various sources, including official rulebooks, tournament reports, and expert analyses, we aim to provide a comprehensive understanding of why Pot of Greed remains a cornerstone in the Yu-Gi-Oh! community. Card Mechanics and Functionality Pot of Greed is a Spell Card categorized under the "Normal Spell" type. Its primary function is remarkably straightforward: it allows the player to draw two additional cards from their deck and add them to their hand. The card's text reads: "Draw 2 cards." This simplicity belies its profound impact on gameplay. In the context of Yu-Gi-Oh!, card advantage—the concept of obtaining more cards than the opponent—is a crucial strategic element. Pot of Greed directly contributes to card advantage by increasing the player's hand size, providing more options for plays, and enhancing the overall flexibility of the player's strategy. Drawing two cards can lead to finding key combo pieces, enhancing the consistency of decks, and accelerating the player's ability to execute complex strategies. 7:07 PM Historical Significance Introduced early in the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG's history, Pot of Greed quickly became a staple in competitive play. Its availability in various formats and its unquestionable utility made it a favorite among duelists. However, its pervasive power also led to significant changes in the game's structure. The card's dominance was such that it contributed to the game's balance issues, prompting its eventual ban in official tournaments. According to official announcements by Konami, the company behind Yu-Gi-Oh!, Pot of Greed was banned in April 2005 for being too powerful and for its potential to create an unfair advantage, leading to less dynamic and more stagnant gameplay (Konami, 2005). This decision was part of a broader effort to regulate card strength and maintain a balanced competitive environment. The ban on Pot of Greed, along with other powerful cards, helped shift the game's meta towards more strategic and diverse deck-building, reducing the prevalence of overpowering, single-strategy decks. 7:07 PM Impact on Gameplay and Meta The removal of Pot of Greed from the official card pool had significant ramifications on the game's meta. Prior to its ban, decks that could leverage the card's draw power had a substantial edge, often dictating the flow of matches. Players could quickly cycle through their decks, accessing key cards with ease, which in turn made certain strategies almost unbeatable. Post-ban, the Yu-Gi-Oh! community saw a diversification of viable decks and strategies. The absence of Pot of Greed forced players to seek alternative methods for achieving card advantage, leading to the emergence of more intricate and varied gameplay styles. This shift not only enhanced the strategic depth of the game but also increased its accessibility, allowing for a wider range of competitive and casual playstyles to flourish. Moreover, the legacy of Pot of Greed continues to influence modern Yu-Gi-Oh! card design and balance considerations. Developers often reference the card's impact when evaluating the power levels of new cards, striving to avoid similar imbalances that could disrupt the game's competitive integrity. 7:07 PM Legal Status and Variations While Pot of Greed remains banned in the official tournament settings, it is still available for use in casual play and among collectors. Its status varies across different regions and formats, but the general consensus aligns with Konami's initial decision to restrict its use in sanctioned events. Interestingly, Pot of Greed has inspired various similar cards and effects in the Yu-Gi-Oh! universe. Cards like "Graceful Charity" and "Upstart Goblin" offer comparable draw mechanics, each with their unique limitations and strategic implications. These cards provide players with alternatives that balance utility with the game's competitive fairness, ensuring that the ability to draw additional cards remains a valuable yet controlled aspect of gameplay. Strategic Considerations and Deck Building In deck construction, the inclusion or exclusion of Pot of Greed—or its alternatives—can significantly influence a deck's performance and strategy. For decks that prioritize speed and consistency, card draw is essential. Without Pot of Greed, players must rely on other draw mechanisms, such as "Pot of Prosperity" or "Pot of Extravagance," each introducing different dynamics and strategic choices. The decision to include specific draw cards impacts the deck's overall balance between aggression, defense, and versatility. Players must carefully evaluate how additional card draw aligns with their deck's primary strategy, ensuring that they maintain a cohesive and effective approach to dueling. Furthermore, the reliance on draw power underscores the importance of resource management in Yu-Gi-Oh!. Effective use of Pot of Greed or similar cards can dictate the pace of the game, allowing players to maintain momentum and adapt to their opponent's strategies. Conversely, overreliance on card draw can lead to predictability and vulnerability if the draw mechanism is disrupted by opposing effects. 7:07 PM Pot of Greed in Competitive Play In competitive settings, Pot of Greed's influence was profound before its ban. Top-tier decks often included the card to ensure they could consistently access their key strategies. Its ability to provide immediate card advantage made it a valuable asset in high-stakes matches, where every draw could make the difference between victory and defeat. Tournament reports and historical match analyses from the early 2000s illustrate how Pot of Greed was central to the success of numerous deck archetypes. The card's presence often determined the meta, with players prioritizing decks that could maximize its benefits while mitigating its potential drawbacks. Post-ban, the competitive landscape has evolved, with the focus shifting towards more balanced and strategic deck-building. The absence of Pot of Greed has allowed for a more diverse array of strategies to thrive, promoting a healthier and more dynamic competitive environment. 7:07 PM Psychological and Cultural Impact Beyond its mechanical impact, Pot of Greed holds a significant place in the cultural and psychological fabric of the Yu-Gi-Oh! community. For many players, the card represents the quintessential "power card"—a simple yet game-changing effect that embodies the excitement and strategic depth of the game. The card's notoriety has cemented its status as a collector's item, often sought after for its rarity and historical significance. Its legacy is celebrated in various media, including anime, manga, and online forums, where discussions about its impact and potential reintroductions continue to engage fans. Moreover, Pot of Greed has become a symbol of the delicate balance between power and fairness in game design. Its story serves as a lesson for both players and designers on the importance of maintaining equilibrium to ensure an engaging and competitive experience for all participants. Conclusion Pot of Greed is more than just a simple card that allows players to draw two additional cards; it is a landmark in the history of Yu-Gi-Oh! that has shaped the game's competitive dynamics, deck-building strategies, and cultural narrative. Its straightforward effect belies the profound impact it has had on gameplay balance and the evolution of the game's meta. The card's eventual ban from official tournaments underscores the challenges inherent in designing and maintaining a balanced competitive environment. Pot of Greed's legacy continues to influence Yu-Gi-Oh!'s development, serving as a benchmark for assessing the power and fairness of new card effects. As the Yu-Gi-Oh! Each of you must submit a vote to eliminate one of your fellow tribemates in your submissions channel by the deadline tomorrow. You may change your vote as many times you would like up until the deadline, but once the deadline passes your vote is locked, and can no longer be changed. The deadline to submit your vote is 10/11/2024 7:00 PM 20 minutes before the deadline, we will begin live Tribal Council, where a member of Production will ask you questions about the game and your experience thus far. When the deadline hits, the live advantage period will begin. You will have 5 minutes to play any advantages you may have found. If you wish to play an advantage but will not be online at this time, you may pre-play it in your submissions channel and we will play it for you.
